reviewer: showcase-gemini (bead o97 — revert-rule live cascade execution and contrast fix)

spec_match.rationale: Live preview exercises the actual revert-rule CSS cascade rollback contract (padding: revert-rule and font-weight: revert-rule) versus manual property re-declaration, backed by live computed-style inspection.

interactive.rationale: Color scheme buttons, strategy toggle buttons, base component padding slider, and live computed style table update in real time on user interaction.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Concept lede matches the feature-index promise on key terms (conditional, dark, mode, revert, rule, undo, cascade).

edge_cases.rationale: Directly contrasts how base component updates propagate under revert-rule versus breaking under rigid manual re-declaration.

references.rationale: Dedicated references section linking ChromeStatus, CSS Cascade 5 specification, and feature index.

design_system.rationale: Both light and dark preview modes provide high-contrast text and buttons exceeding WCAG AAA (8.7:1 and 9.8:1), eliminating the previous 1.75:1 contrast regression.

accessibility.rationale: All interactive controls meet 44px min-height tap targets with visible focus outlines and aria-pressed states on toggle buttons.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified in Chrome DevTools MCP on mobile 360x740 DPR3 (0px overflow) and desktop 1280x800.

summary: conditional-polish updated (bead o97): fixed the 1.75:1 contrast failure in light/dark previews (now 8.7:1 and 9.8:1 WCAG AAA), added live revert-rule CSS cascade execution with base component size slider and computed-style readout, added dedicated references section, and verified 0px mobile overflow at 360px viewport.

guidanceConsulted.query: high contrast dark mode and light mode button styling
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Maintain >=4.5:1 for normal text and >=7:1 for enhanced contrast in both color scheme modes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied. Replaced low-contrast blue-on-charcoal with #ffffff on var(--demo-color-1e40af) (8.72:1) in light mode and #0f172a on #93c5fd (9.8:1) in dark mode.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Chrome DevTools MCP evaluated computed styles: light 8.72:1, dark 9.8:1 (WCAG AAA).

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible toggle button states aria-pressed 44px tap targets
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-pressed on toggle buttons and ensure 44px minimum tap targets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied. All buttons and sliders have min-height: 44px and dynamic aria-pressed attributes.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: DevTools MCP inspection confirmed 44px minHeight and 0px mobile overflow at 360x740.
